plain.li: [opt0,safe] {X_nameDef} came all the way from home to find me. We talked until supper, and not one of us shouted. We're going to write to each other now.
[opt0,risk] {X_nameDef} came to talk, and we ended up shouting the same things we shouted the night I left.
[opt1] The council sent a gift home with {X_nameDef}. I don't know if it helps. It can't hurt.
[opt2] The council sent {X_nameDef} away. I didn't argue. I'm not sure I'm glad.

warm.li: [opt0,safe] {X_nameDef} held my hands the whole time and said I looked well. I think I do.

blunt.li: [opt2] Family came to drag me home. They can stay home.

gloomy.li: [opt0,risk] It went the way it always goes with my family. Badly, and then very quiet.

cold.li: [opt1] We bought some peace from my family with a bag of silver. Cheaper than I'd have guessed.

plain.li: [opt0] A letter from {X_nameDef} today. I wrote back about everything, even the dull parts. {X_nameDef} likes the dull parts.
[opt1] I've asked {X_nameDef} to come and live here. I keep looking down the road.

warm.li: [opt0] {X_nameDef} wrote. The handwriting hasn't changed at all.

cheerful.li: [opt1] {X_nameDef} might come and live here! I've already picked out a spot for {X_possessive} bed.

gloomy.li: [opt0] A letter from home. I read it once and put it away. I'll read it again when I can stand to.

plain.li: I've been waiting for that bad fortune since the cards were read. Today I had a fright and walked away from it. I think that was it.
Nearly came to grief today, and didn't. As far as I'm concerned, that's the fortune used up.

cheerful.li: The bad fortune came and went, and I'm fine! I'm going to stop watching the sky now.

gloomy.li: The cards said something bad. Today something nearly was. I don't feel as relieved as I should.

blunt.li: Close call. I'm done with fortunes.

plain.li: [opt0] {X_nameDef} walked all the way from {FACTION} to ask for me by name. I gave {X_objective} the whole day.
[opt0] They call me {TALE} on the roads now. I'm not sure when that started.
[opt1] Someone came a long way to see me, and I couldn't spare the day. I keep thinking about it.

warm.li: [opt0] Helped {X_nameDef}. It's good to be of use to someone outside these walls.

cheerful.li: [opt0] People come from other villages to ask for me now! Today it was {X_nameDef}.

gloomy.li: [opt0] Known as {TALE}. There are worse things to be known for.

blunt.li: [opt1] Told the stranger no. Too much to do here.

cold.li: [opt0] A stranger paid well for a day of my time. That's how it should be.

plain.li: [opt0] {ENEMY} are coming. I asked for this.
[opt1] {ENEMY} were camped a few hours away, and now they've moved on. I'll get another chance.

gloomy.li: [opt1] They were right there, and they walked away.

cold.li: [opt0] I've drawn them in. Now we finish it.

plain.li: [opt0] Founding day. We ate until we couldn't, and somebody told the story of the first night again. It gets longer every time.
[opt1] Founding day. A quiet supper. I thought about the first night here, and how little we had.

warm.li: [opt0] We raised a cup to everyone who built this place, and then another.

cheerful.li: [opt0] Founding day feast! Three helpings, and I regret nothing.

gloomy.li: [opt1] Another year. I counted the graves on the way to supper.

cold.li: [opt0] A feast for an anniversary. Expensive, but people work harder after one.

plain.li: Met a traveler tonight who'd done the very thing I want to do. I asked questions until the fire went out.
{X_nameDef} stayed the night. I came away with a page of advice and the feeling it can be done.

warm.li: {X_nameDef} was so patient with my questions. I hope I'm like that one day.

blunt.li: Talked with someone who's done it. Useful.

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} made it sound easy. It won't be.

plain.li: [opt0] A stranger came in out of the cold tonight. We talked until the fire was embers.
[opt1] We sent a traveler back out into the cold with bread. I hope {X_nameDef} found somewhere warm.
[opt2] We kept the gate shut on a traveler tonight. I listened to the knocking until it stopped.

warm.li: [opt0] Shared the fire with {X_nameDef} tonight. Good company, cold feet.

gloomy.li: [opt2] Someone knocked at the gate tonight, in that cold. We didn't open it.

cold.li: [opt1] Fed the stranger and sent {X_objective} on. Sensible.

plain.li: [opt0,safe] I won over the strange creature by the fields. It was eating out of my hand by sundown.
[opt0,risk] I got close to the strange creature, a few steps away, and then it bolted.
[opt1] There was a strange creature grazing near the fields. We let it be. I'd have liked to try.

warm.li: [opt0,safe] It nuzzled my hand once it trusted me. I'm going to remember that.

cheerful.li: [opt0,safe] The strange creature from the fields follows me everywhere now! It needs a name.

gloomy.li: [opt0,risk] It ran. They always run from me.
